source_description: Local invocation of the persisted Hermes workflow. Telegram was not used for these runs.

runs.question: 5 kota dengan rata-rata skor enam faktor tertinggi pada tiga bulan terakhir yang tersedia

rules: Synthetic cohort only. All assessment records are final.
Join assessment.umkm_id to analytics_umkms.id; no raw history-to-history joins.
Tiga Dimensi scores use 0-100. Six factor scores use 1-5 and total_score uses 6-30.
period_month is YYYY-MM, interpreted in WIB. Latest uses timestamp then id.
Use positional ? for strings and user input. The query limit is at most 200.

plan.sql: SELECT u.city AS kota, COUNT(*) AS observasi, ROUND(AVG(e.total_score), 2) AS rata_rata FROM analytics_six_factor_evaluations AS e JOIN analytics_umkms AS u ON e.umkm_id = u.id WHERE e.period_month BETWEEN ? AND ? GROUP BY u.city ORDER BY AVG(e.total_score) DESC, u.city ASC LIMIT 5

intent.metric: rata-rata skor total Enam Faktor (total_score) per kota
intent.period: 2026-08 hingga 2026-10, tiga bulan terakhir yang tersedia secara inklusif
intent.sort: Rata-rata total_score menurun; tie-breaker nama kota menaik

mysql.validated_sql: SELECT u.city AS kota, COUNT(*) AS observasi, ROUND(AVG(e.total_score), 2) AS rata_rata FROM analytics_six_factor_evaluations AS e JOIN analytics_umkms AS u ON e.umkm_id = u.id WHERE e.period_month BETWEEN ? AND ? GROUP BY u.city ORDER BY AVG(e.total_score) DESC, u.city ASC LIMIT 5
